notes.title: What Comes Next
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everyone who’s played Túatha Echoes: The Village! Your feedback has been invaluable and continues to inspire us.

We’re excited to give you a glimpse of what’s in the works for the next chapter in the Túatha Echoes series. While we're keeping the title a mystery for now, we can’t wait to share some of the exciting new features we’re bringing to the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42137095/c589b54feb8ed1b917c3458da428a12201578f25.png[/img]
This time around, we’re creating beautifully hand-drawn artwork to bring every character, environment, and scene to life with even more detail and care.

But it’s not just about what you see. Based on your feedback, we’re making sure the world feels more alive and engaging. Interactive environments and characters will give you the freedom to explore, engage, and uncover the world in your own way.

With more freedom comes more choice. The decisions you make will shape the direction of your story, leading to multiple handcrafted conclusions for you to discover.

We’re continuing to expand the worlds and lore of Túatha Echoes, and we can’t wait to show you what’s in store — but not today.

Stay tuned and follow us for all the latest updates!

notes.title: Túatha Echoes: The Village is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Túatha Echoes: The Village is Now Live!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42137095/a75ccfdb55ab76b33f246db1bd5167b83c20f5a8.png[/img]
The time has come—Túatha Echoes: The Village is now available to play for free!

We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who has supported us through the pre-release period. Your feedback from the demo has been invaluable, helping us refine the experience and shape the game into what it is today. We've learned a lot throughout this journey, and we're excited to carry those lessons forward into our next project.

Speaking of what’s next—the team has been hard at work on the next story in the Túatha Echoes franchise. We’ll have more to share in the coming weeks, so be sure to follow the game to stay updated on what’s to come.

For now, step into the cursed village, uncover its dark secrets, and let the whispers guide your way.

Follow and download for free—we can't wait to share more stories of Túatha with you!

notes.title: The Shadows Reveal: Release Date Unveiled!
notes.notes:
The whispers have spoken...

You’ve wandered in darkness, searching for answers, and now, the time draws near. The shadows have been watching, guiding you, waiting for the moment to reveal the truth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42137095/a75ccfdb55ab76b33f246db1bd5167b83c20f5a8.png[/img]

On the 4th of March 2025, Túatha Echoes: The Village will emerge from the shadows, and best of all—it will be completely free for all to experience. Journey into the cursed village and uncover the dark origins of a soul lost to madness, shaped by forces unknown.

The whispers may guide you, but it is up to you to take the first step. Add Túatha Echoes: The Village to your wishlist today so you don't miss any updates. Heed the call of the shadows, and prepare yourself for what awaits.

Wishlist and follow so you stay up-to-date

notes.title: The Wait is Over – Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
The whispers have led you here, and now it’s time to step into the shadows. The Túatha Echoes: The Village Demo is live, ready for you to explore its world of ancient magic and forgotten legends.

As you journey through the village, you’ll feel the presence of primal forces and uncover mysteries woven into the land itself. This demo introduces the first 4 scenes, offering a glimpse into the story we’re building. The full experience will span 13 scenes, revealing much more as the story unfolds.

We’re a small team, and Túatha is a world we've poured a lot of heart into. Your feedback means the world to us, and we’d love to hear your thoughts as we continue shaping this game—and the ones to follow.

Don’t forget to add the full game to your Wishlist to stay updated on changes and announcements. And feel free to stop by the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1024120/discussions/0/4696783122979458102/]community forums[/url] to connect with other players and chat with the dev team!

Play the Túatha Echoes: The Village Demo today!

notes.title: Step Into the Shadows
notes.notes:
The world of Túatha is a place of untamed wonder, where ancient magic pulses through the land, and shadows carry the weight of forgotten legends. In the heart of this vast wilderness lies a village—silent now, but once alive with song and celebration. The air hums with mystery, and danger lingers in every breath.

Here, in this hidden valley, a story begins. A tale of a soul whose actions will ripple through the ages, shaping the world in ways both great and terrible. As you step into Túatha Echoes: The Village, you will uncover the origins of one who will leave an indelible mark on this primal land—one whose fate is intertwined with the whispers of the wilds.

Take the first steps of your journey into this enigmatic world on 15th October 2024, when the Túatha Echoes: The Village Demo releases.

The whispers beckon—Wishlist and Follow now.
